name: Every Click Get +1 Jump
desc:
Welcome to Every Click Get +1 Jump!
With every click you gain +1 Jump Power! Strive to the top, use your jump power to get wins by completing the towers!
You can now HOLD your Click!

Premium players get 1.5X Jump

NOTE: This game just RELEASED so report any bugs to me, also A LOT of UPDATES are yet to come!

Join the group for more updates!

Make sure to Like and Favorite if you enjoyed it does help a lot!
